entry_mode_text: Market sell at the daily-open anchor 09:00 broker time (07:00 UK), the standing anchor of the instance in force. Fill level is the reference close of the last completed cash session before the report date, 7411.00 on 2026-06-08.
management_text: Three equal units. Unit 1 exits at 7332.99 (1R, 78.01 pts). Unit 2 exits at 7254.98 (2R, 156.02 pts); on that fill Unit 3 stop moves to entry minus 0.2R = 7395.40. Unit 3 is a runner, time-stopped at the cash-session close or price-stopped at the three-ATR cap 7198.49 (212.51 pts from entry), whichever comes first. Wide-stop flag RAISED: R = 78.01 pts = 1.10 x ATR14 (70.84), above 1.00 x ATR14; the stop is structural, not discretionary, and is not tightened to clear the flag. Stop distance is well inside the 3.5 x ATR cap of 247.92 pts. Thesis invalidation, distinct from the stop: a daily close back above the 2026-06-08 session high 7471.30 (60.30 pts above entry, 17.71 pts below the stop) - that is the level the stop is buffered beyond, and a close through it, not merely a touch, ends the short thesis. Event risk inside the holding window: Existing Home Sales 17:00 broker on the report date, and the 16-17 June policy meeting flagged by the report as the dominant forward catalyst.
rationale: REFERENCE CLOSE. The last completed primary-asset session strictly before the report date is 2026-06-08 (Monday). Its settled cash-session close (16:30-23:00 broker, the 09:30-16:00 ET regular session the report declares as its price basis) is 7411.00. That is the reference close for every card in this set. The full broker-day close of the same session is 7406.80 and is stated only for basis transparency; it is not the reference. The report's own consensus close of 7383.74 is the 2026-06-05 close and is one session stale, so the MARKET entry is 7411.00, not 7383.74. DIRECTION. The report resolves the conviction score to SHORT at -0.68, which clears the 0.25 conviction threshold in absolute terms, so Trade 1 is not suppressed on the neutral-score trigger. ATR14. 70.84 index points, 14 sessions ending 2026-06-08, computed on cash-session bars (16:30-23:00 broker) using true range = max(H-L, |H-prevC|, |L-prevC|). On full broker-day bars the same window gives 84.69; the cash basis is used throughout because the report's declared price basis is the regular cash session, and it is the basis on which the 5-day block, the swings and the pivots below are all measured. The report never states an ATR number at all - it only implies about 71.4 from a '100 pts is about 1.4x' remark - so this value is taken from the slice. STOP. Tighter of (a) the 5-day swing high 7624.60 (2026-06-02) and (b) the nearest resistance visible in the 5-day validated structure, which is the 2026-06-08 session high 7471.30 - the level the D-1 rally was rejected from, price then closing back at 7411.00. The tighter anchor is 7471.30. Stop = 7471.30 + 0.25 x 70.84 = 7489.01. R = 7489.01 - 7411.00 = 78.01 pts = 1.10 x ATR14, inside the 0.3-3.0 x ATR14 band (21.25 to 212.51) and far inside the 3.5 x ATR14 cap (247.92), so the cap does not bind and the wide-stop flag is raised rather than the stop being moved. Note on divergence: the QA note for this date anchors the stop on daily R1 7455.27 and arrives at 7472.98 / R = 61.98. R1 is a pivot level, not the nearest-support/resistance value the stop rule names, and the stop rule reads that value from the 5-day OHLC structure; the 2026-06-08 high 7471.30 is the level that structure actually provides, so the stop is built on it. TARGETS. TP1 = entry - 1R = 7332.99; TP2 = entry - 2R = 7254.98; TP3 is the runner's three-ATR price cap, entry - 3 x 70.84 = 7198.49. TP1 sits 78.01 pts from entry, inside the 2.5 x ATR14 reachability band of 177.09 pts. ORDER SIDE. MARKET card, entry equals the reference close exactly, signed gap 0.00. ANCHOR. 09:00 broker = 07:00 UK, the standing daily-open anchor. The report overrode this to 00:00 UK on a run-time instruction and then remapped the fill to the 14:30 UK cash open; that override is not honoured here - the anchor rule is not re-selected per run, and no run-time instruction relaxes it.

entry_mode_text: Sell limit resting at 7422.61, monitored from 09:00 broker time (07:00 UK). The level sits 11.61 pts above the reference close of 7411.00, which is the side a sell limit must be on; price is already below the pivot, so the breakdown level can only be worked as a limit, not as a stop order.
management_text: Three equal units on a sell limit at 7422.61. Unit 1 exits at the first support tier 7382.77 (39.84 pts, 1.47R). Unit 2 exits at the mid tier 7368.65 (53.96 pts, 2.00R); on that fill Unit 3 stop moves to entry plus 0.2R = 7428.01. Unit 3 traces toward the second support tier 7354.53 (68.08 pts, 2.52R) and is not time-stopped. R = 27.01 pts = 0.38 x ATR14 (70.84); no wide-stop flag, R is below 1.00 x ATR14. Thesis invalidation, distinct from the stop: a daily close back above the daily pivot 7427.03 would put price back inside the pivot structure and end the breakdown thesis; that level sits 4.42 pts above entry and 22.59 pts below the stop, and it is a close-through condition rather than an intraday touch - the stop stands ahead of the invalidation. Event risk inside the holding window: Existing Home Sales 17:00 broker on the report date and the 16-17 June policy meeting.
rationale: REFERENCE CLOSE. 7411.00, the settled cash close of 2026-06-08, the last completed session strictly before the report date. BRANCH. The report classifies the regime as Transitional, and that one label governs the whole set. The transition branch of the pivot trade permits a breakout-side entry only; a counter-side mean-reversion limit is not available under this label and is not built. The breakout side taken is the downside: the report's medium-term bias is bearish, its directional conviction is SHORT at -0.68, its forecast expects a test of the 7300 area, and the D-1 session rallied to 7471.30 and then closed at 7411.00, back below the daily pivot 7427.03. PIVOT DERIVATION. Daily floor pivots from the prior period, which for a report dated 2026-06-09 is the D-1 session 2026-06-08 itself: H 7471.30, L 7398.80, C 7411.00, all cash-session values read from the slice. P = (7471.30 + 7398.80 + 7411.00)/3 = 7427.03; R1 = 2P - L = 7455.27; R2 = P + (H-L) = 7499.53; S1 = 2P - H = 7382.77; S2 = P - (H-L) = 7354.53; the derived mid tier S1.5 = (S1+S2)/2 = 7368.65. Identity check: R2 - P = P - S2 = 72.50 = H - L, and R1 - P = P - S1 = 28.23, both hold. These inputs are two-source-grade broker bars from the slice, so no tier is single-source indicative and the suppression trigger that the original report fired on does not fire here; the report's own pivots (P 7449.58, R1 7519.16, S1 7314.16) were built from the 2026-06-05 session and from a high overstated by roughly 40 pts, and are not used. ENTRY. Breakout-side entry is 10 percent of the way from the pivot toward the first support tier: P - 0.10 x (P - S1) = 7427.03 - 4.43 = 7422.61. ORDER SIDE. Sell limit, 11.61 pts above the 7411.00 reference close, which satisfies the requirement that a sell limit sit at or above that close. STOP. P + 0.8 x (R1 - P) = 7427.03 + 22.59 = 7449.62. The confluence alternative - the prior-day high 7471.30 sits above R1, giving R1 + 0.25 x ATR14 = 7472.98 - is the wider of the two, and the rule takes whichever is tighter, so 7449.62 stands. R = 27.01 pts = 0.38 x ATR14 on the cash basis and 0.32 x ATR14 on the full broker-day basis (84.69); both are above the 0.30 floor, and the R value is fixed by the pivot geometry, so there is no discretion to widen it. TARGETS. TP1 / TP2 / TP3 are the support tiers S1 7382.77, S1.5 7368.65, S2 7354.53. TP1 lies 39.84 pts from entry, well inside the 2.5 x ATR14 reachability band of 177.09 pts. LADDER. Short ordering holds: stop 7449.62 above entry 7422.61 above TP1 7382.77 above TP2 7368.65 above TP3 7354.53. ANCHOR. 09:00 broker = 07:00 UK, the standing daily-open anchor, stated identically on every card in this set.

rationale: RE-EVALUATION. This record was rewritten in the corroboration correction pass (M5 §5.2a and §10 as amended at f69b2cd). The earlier treatment of inputs struck from the broker price series as SINGLE-SOURCE-INDICATIVE was a misapplication of the corroboration gate: that gate exists for prior-period levels taken from narrative or aggregator quotes whose true H/L cannot be established. The broker series in the D-1 slice is the series the order would be filled and settled against - the settlement source, not a secondary quote about the market - so anything computed from it is CORROBORATED by construction and no second source is required or possible. Every input below has therefore been recomputed from that series and flagged accordingly. The corroboration ground does not stand against this card. REFERENCE CLOSE. 7411.00, the settled cash close (16:30-23:00 broker) of 2026-06-08, the last completed primary-asset session strictly before the report date; unchanged from the rest of this date's set. ATR14. 70.84 index points, 14 cash sessions ending 2026-06-08 (84.69 on full broker-day bars); unchanged. REGIME. Transitional, as the report classifies it in its medium-term regime section, its short-term judgement label and its forward view; unchanged. That label is the single source of truth for the complex-trade fork and it selects the momentum-breakout variant, 3C. It does not select the momentum-pullback variant, which is reserved for a trending label, and where the selected variant fails its own eligibility test the outcome is a suppressed row - never a substitution of a different variant and never pivot levels standing in for range levels. INPUTS RECOMPUTED, CORROBORATION FLAG = CORROBORATED. Series: the broker price series in data/slices/US500/US500_upto_2026-06-08.csv, last bar 2026-06-08 23:45:00 broker - the execution and settlement series for this instrument. Sessions: the 25 cash sessions from 2026-05-05 to 2026-06-08 inclusive. Upper range boundary (swing_high_25d) 7624.60, the cash-session high of 2026-06-02. Lower range boundary (swing_low_25d) 7242.90, the cash-session low of 2026-05-05. Range width 381.70 pts. Confirmation threshold 0.25 x ATR14 = 0.25 x 70.84 = 17.71 pts, giving an upside arming close of 7642.31 and a downside arming close of 7225.19. All three inputs are struck from the broker series over sessions that are themselves in the slice, so each carries the CORROBORATED flag by construction; none is inherited from a report quote. Cross-check on the full broker-day basis over the same 25 sessions gives 7624.60 / 7202.10 against a full-day close of 7406.80 - the same verdict on either basis, so nothing turns on the choice of basis. SUPPRESSION TESTS RE-RUN. (1) Confirmed break, M5 §4d and the §10 trigger 'No confirmed break per §4d in TRANSITION regime': the reference close 7411.00 sits mid-range, 213.60 pts below 7624.60 and 168.10 pts above 7242.90, and would need to travel a further 231.31 pts up or 185.81 pts down to reach an arming close. No confirmed break exists. FIRES - and it is a price test against the reference close, wholly independent of corroboration, so the correction pass leaves it standing. This is the ground on which the card remains suppressed. (2) Corroboration: does not fire - the §10 corroboration trigger is a Trade 2 pivot-tier gate and, in any case, every input this card uses is CORROBORATED per §5.2a as amended. (3) atr_14 present, positive: does not fire. (4) No-qualifying-swing: 3C is expressly exempt under §10 because its anchor is the 25-day range boundary rather than the swing; recorded for completeness, the 2026-06-02 high 7624.60 down to the 2026-06-05 low 7372.80 is a 251.80 pt swing, 3.55 x ATR14, so the test would not have fired anyway. That swing cannot be used to build a pullback card, because the transitional label does not select that variant. OUTCOME. Suppressed row, on the confirmed-break test alone. No entry, stop, R or ladder is carried, and no card is forced into existence on the strength of the corrected corroboration finding. ANCHOR. 09:00 broker = 07:00 UK, stated for consistency with the rest of the set even though no order is worked.
